content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk blend sheath dress, knee-length silhouette, deep emerald green (#043927), smooth woven fabric; tailored wool-blend blazer, classic fit, cropped length to waist, charcoal grey (#36454F), heavy textured weave. Leather pumps, pointed toe, mid-heel height, black (#000000), polished calfskin. Pearl drop earrings, 12mm diameter, white pearl, gold-plated brass; thin leather clutch, structured box shape, ivory cream (#FFFFF0), grained cowhide. This ensemble honors the formal dress code for an outdoor late-afternoon wedding while transitioning seamlessly into a restaurant setting. The rich emerald shade complements the August season without appearing too light for evening artificial lighting, and the structured blazer adds the necessary elegance expected of a sister's wedding guest. By choosing natural fibres like silk and wool, the outfit ensures comfort during the outdoor ceremony before moving indoors."}
